name: Meta-evaluation Benchmark for Text-to-image Generation
description: A manually annotated meta-evaluation benchmark including chain-of-thought explanations and quality scores for generated images, designed to reliably assess automatic evaluation methods for text-to-image generation.
reputation: A very recent meta-evaluation benchmark with limited community adoption so far, mainly intended to assess automatic evaluators for text-to-image generation.
notes: Supports training of distilled open-source MLLMs and improves evaluation scalability compared to commercial MLLMs.
